title: Classy meal for two (Unsplash).jpg
author: Brooke Lark brookelark
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2016-05-18, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Soft window daylight, weathered oak table, cream curtains: airy and warm, big calm top half for a navy headline.
concerns: Wine glass and stew read 'restaurant' more than 'shop'; crop to the right half for cafés.

title: Ben Garratt 2016 (Unsplash).jpg
author: Ben Garratt wstn
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2016-09-09, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Sourdough on a light wood board from above: warm, clean, lots of pale wood around it for text.
concerns: Slightly washed-out wood; fine on butter yellow, may want a touch of warmth.

title: Man holding bread (Unsplash).jpg
author: Kate Remmer studioktr
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2017-02-12, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Hands cradling a loaf in a linen cloth, navy shirt behind: tactile, human, and the blue echoes Corner's navy.
concerns: Torso only (no face). Darker background than 01/02, so text goes beside rather than over.

title: Annie Spratt 2016-02-14 (Unsplash OyUUIbN4a3c).jpg
author: Annie Spratt anniespratt
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2016-02-14, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Moka pot, croissants and coffee bag on oak, from above: morning-café warmth.
concerns: Small printed label on the coffee bag and a card with a logo at the top edge: crop the top ~15%.

title: Vegetable Market (Unsplash).jpg
author: Lukas Budimaier lukasbudimaier
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2016-05-16, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Market crates from above: ochre lemons, melons, potatoes; graphic grid that works as a full-width band.
concerns: Handwritten price cards (Spanish) are legible but generic, no brand.

title: Bread (Unsplash).jpg
author: Kim Cruickshanks helloimkim
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2016-12-16, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Dark-crust loaves with yellow flowers: rich, warm, artisan bakery.
concerns: Fairly busy; best as a wide in the Products grid, not under text.

title: Making pottery (Unsplash).jpg
author: Jared Sluyter jaredsluyter
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2017-03-29, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Hands shaping clay on a wheel from above: the clearest 'maker' image, terracotta tones.

title: Pottery and craft (Unsplash).jpg
author: Alex Jones alexjones
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2015-01-25, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Clay-covered hands on a pale table, shallow focus: quiet and tactile, ideal for About.
concerns: Muted, slightly cool; pairs best next to warmer wood shots.

title: Woodworker in a workshop (Unsplash).jpg
author: Ian Schneider goian
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2016-05-12, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Woodworker sanding a walnut board among shavings, seen from behind: workshop and hands.
concerns: Back of head/hair visible (no face). Somewhat dark floor.

title: Werkstatt Werkzeuge work shop tools 690038.jpg
author: Igor Trepeshchenok
why: Wall of chisels, saws and planes on pale wood: orderly, warm, perfect full-width workshop band.
concerns: A bit flat/even; wall sockets bottom-left (crop).

title: Shaving wood (Unsplash).jpg
author: fireskystudios.com asthetik
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2014-10-28, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Hand plane with curled wood shavings, very shallow focus: calm, lots of negative space.
concerns: Desaturated grey-lavender cast; warm it slightly to match the set.

title: Nathan Dumlao 2017-05-27 (Unsplash).jpg
author: Nathan Dumlao nate_dumlao
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2017-05-27, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Pouring coffee into a cup on a worn wooden counter, portrait: warm, candid hands.
concerns: Darker; Unsplash date 2017-05-27 is close to the June 2017 licence change (still before it).

title: Breakfast on a table (Unsplash).jpg
author: Katerina Pavlickova katerinapavlickova
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2016-10-04, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Cappuccino and croissant on pale wood, bright daylight, portrait: the lightest tall in the set.
concerns: Simple/clean; a little 'stock'. Only 2912x4368 needed is fine.

title: Pink carnation bouquets (Unsplash).jpg
author: Lizzie amianyuhua
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2017-05-09, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Carnations wrapped in kraft paper on white linen, portrait: florist/shop feel, soft and fresh.
concerns: Wrapping has a tiny printed tag (not legible at web sizes).

title: Large ceramic bottles (Unsplash).jpg
author: Jessica Ruscello jruscello
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2016-12-10, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Rows of glazed ceramic bottles in sage and blue: the blue bonus, calm shop-shelf feel.
concerns: Cooler than the rest; use once as a wide accent.

title: Barcelona, Spain (Unsplash oH66az yug).jpg
author: Roman Kraft romankraft
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2017-02-14, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Flower shop front with crates, ladders and buckets on a street: the 'small shop' image.
concerns: Chalkboard has handwritten (Spanish) menu text, no brand; busy, best as wide not hero.

title: Lemon and lavender Bread (Unsplash).jpg
author: Annie Spratt anniespratt
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2016-09-07, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Lemon-lavender loaf on a cooling rack, linen and lemons: bright, homely journal cover.
concerns: Flat-lay with cooler white; embroidered cloth edge is fussy.

title: Coffee from a steel kettle (Unsplash).jpg
author: Annie Spratt anniespratt
licence: CC0 (Commons; Unsplash photo dated 2016-02-14, before the June 2017 licence change)
why: Coffee pouring from a moka pot into a blue-striped cup: warm with a navy-blue note, journal cover.
